component.name: Snapline
component.summary: Region screenshots with annotation and upload

description.p: Press a hotkey, drag over the part of the screen you want, mark it up, then copy it, save it, print it or upload it and get a link in your clipboard.

ul.li: Pen, line, arrow, rectangle, circle, marker, text and blur tools with undo/redo
Copy, save, print, or upload to Imgur or your own server
Share links and reverse image search
Works on X11 and Wayland (GNOME, KDE, Sway, Hyprland), multi-monitor and HiDPI
